Requirement: The spacecraft shall limit the release of debris during deployment to a probability below 0.1 %, consistent with ISO 24113.
The spacecraft shall re-enter the atmosphere within 25 years after end of mission.
The power subsystem shall passivate stored energy at end of mission by depleting the battery below 1 V.
The bus shall provide 5 V within 0.2 V to the payload.
The flight software must be reliable.
The supplier shall keep a single programme organisation, with named authorities for cost, schedule, and technical decisions.
The operator display shall demonstrate the safe-mode indication.
